about.stats.conclusion: Traditional job boards give you volume. Student Compass gives you quality.
about.stats.items.0.body: of hiring managers say applicants lack relevant experience — a major barrier for entry-level candidates entering the workforce.
about.stats.items.0.citation.1: Survey of 504 hiring decision-makers across Canada. 45% of companies say candidates don't have relevant experience; 54% say it's difficult to find the right candidates.
about.stats.items.0.citation.2: "Lack of relevant experience" cited as a top hiring barrier for entry-level positions.
about.stats.items.0.citationTitle: 49% — Lack of Relevant Experience in Entry-Level Hiring
about.stats.items.1.body: average cost of employee turnover in Canada — and bad hires that leave early can cost significantly more.
about.stats.items.1.citation.0: Express Employment Professionals — Canadian Hiring Outlook (2026)
about.stats.items.1.citation.1: Average cost of employee turnover per employee in Canada, including recruiting, training, and lost productivity. Hiring outlook dampened due to skills gaps and technological shifts.
about.stats.items.1.citation.3: 33% of Canadian professionals plan to search for a new job in 2026, signaling significant workforce rotation and compounding turnover costs for employers.
about.stats.items.1.citationTitle: $30,680 — Average Cost of Employee Turnover in Canada
about.stats.items.2.body: of Canadian hiring managers say resumes don't match candidates' real skills — with AI making exaggeration easier.
about.stats.items.2.citation.1: 82% of hiring managers report that resumes sometimes or often misrepresent candidate skills. AI-generated content is making exaggeration even easier to produce at scale.
about.stats.items.2.citation.2: Data sourced from the Express Job Insights Canada survey program.
about.stats.title: The Hiring Problem No One Talks About
